text:
sasha: Canary showed immediate evict+refetch loops after leader failover. Hypothesis: handoff leaves inconsistent recency. Proposal: attach Ticket(node_id,counter) + access_epoch to residency. eviction order = (access_epoch desc, ticket desc). Soft-pin transferred prefixes for short window.

mike: how are tickets issued? global or node-local? wrap risk?

sasha: node-local 64-bit counter + node_id. on restart node publishes tombstone with last counter; others treat lower counters as expired. wrap unlikely.

anna: won't an old ticket keep a stale prefix alive if new owner never bumps it?

 sasha: access_epoch bumped on access and used as primary order; ticket only tie-breaks. also a short soft-pin on transfers.

jordan: race: eviction at source while dest is pulling?

 sasha: handshake: source sets TRANSFERRING flag + last_ticket; dest pulls, ACKs, adopts ticket; source defers eviction until ACK or timeout. eviction checks TRANSFERRING.

mike: rehydrate: background fills might create lower-priority duplicates.

 sasha: background fills must request owner ticket before promoting; otherwise remain transient.

anna: rollout: advertise fields without changing comparator, collect telemetry, opt-in per shard, flip default.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: CI kv-cache/evict-ticket-sim flaky, recent run 2/3 seeds passed, see https://ci.internal/12345

sasha: I'll draft RFC + tests (comparator units, tombstone recovery, chaos failover with rehydrate+evict) and link here when ready. :thumbsup:
